title: Decent size but it has giant cracks from top to bottom and is falling apart
text:
Decent size but it has giant cracks from top to bottom and is falling apart. I think them inserting the rod into this is tearing them up... It has huge stress cracks up and own it and the cracks go all the way thru so they are barely hanging on.

The crystals themselves are kind of ugly and not pure looking at all. The purple color is very light and then all of the crystals have strange dark spots in the crystals that looks like someone flicked paint all over it. (but the specs are IN the crystals)

For the price I think this size of geode is an okay deal but for the quality you get, I just don't know. I think I'd be angry if I paid full price for this on Amazon if I'm being honest. I certainly won't be purchasing any of these from them after this!
